title: Voice Studio
revisionConflict: This script changed elsewhere. Keep your draft here, or reopen the saved script after keeping a copy of your changes.
takeInUse: This audio is selected in a script. Clear or replace that selection before deleting it.
generationUnavailable: This model or voice is unavailable. Choose an available option before generating again.
leaveDescription: Your latest dialogue changes have not been saved. Cancel to keep editing and retry saving, or leave and discard these changes.
invalidTags: Too many tags or a tag is too long. Check the configured limits.
description: Write dialogue, direct the delivery, and keep the Takes you love.
creator: Create voice
startDescription: Create a script and add a character voice to begin.
characterDescription: Choose a reusable voice for each character. Changing a preset keeps previous audio intact.
dialoguePlaceholder: Write the words this character will say…
estimate: Reserve up to {credits} Credits; actual usage settles after generation
stale: This audio belongs to an earlier version of the dialogue or voice settings.
missingAudio: Choose a Take for every included row before playing the script.
name: Name
deleteDescription: Delete “{name}”? Audio used by a selected Take must be unselected first. This action does not remove billing records.
noAudio: No matching audio yet. Generate a dialogue row to create your first Take.
statusUnavailable: Unable to read generation status. Retry without purchasing another Take.
playbackFailed: Unable to start audio. Use the player to try again.
downloadFailed: Unable to download audio. Try again.
reconciliation: Generation needs reconciliation. Contact support with operation {id} before trying again.
styleScope: Delivery applies to this row. Your character’s voice stays the same.
wholeScriptModel: Model · applies to the entire script
textLimit: This event would exceed the configured dialogue length. Shorten the text first.
unsupportedEvents: Unsupported vocal events: {tokens}. Remove or replace them before generating.
designDescription: Describe a reusable voice identity. This creates a new voice and sample; sentence-level emotion stays in the dialogue editor.
designExample: An adult Thai male voice in his early thirties. Warm and resonant, with clear Thai pronunciation, a gentle texture and a calm, confident baseline. Suitable for a period-drama lead.
designHints: Describe age, vocal texture, accent and baseline personality. Keep momentary emotion in each dialogue row.
designUnavailable: Voice design is unavailable for the configured models. Existing prebuilt voices and saved audio remain available.
designRecovery: This design is still being checked. Keep operation {id} for support; check its status before requesting another voice.
designSampleReady: The provider returned this sample. Listen before saving the voice.
customLoadFailed: Could not load your voices. Retry to recover existing voices instead of designing again.
noSavedVoices: No saved custom voices match. Create a voice, listen to the sample, then save it here.
deleteVoiceDescription: Delete “{name}” and its remote voice identity? Reassign every bound character first, including archived characters. Existing dialogue Takes and billing evidence stay intact.
voiceMetadataScope: Name and display description do not change the voice identity. Design a new voice to change its sound.
myVoicesDescription: Your designed voices and configured prebuilt voices, ready to assign to characters.
noCustomVoices: No matching designed voices yet. Create one from a description, then listen and save.
sharedPresetWarning: Changing this character’s voice affects every row using this character. Accepted generations and existing Takes keep their original voice.
customVoiceInUse: This voice is bound to a character. Open Character voices and reassign all bound characters, including archived ones, before deleting.
voiceQuotaReached: The custom voice or candidate limit has been reached. Save useful candidates and delete unneeded unbound voices before trying again.
voiceConnectionChanged: The provider connection changed. Check this voice’s availability before using it again.
settlementPending: Voice generated. Credit settlement is pending.
usageReconciliationPending: Voice generated. Provider usage needs review.
usageAllowanceReview: Voice generated. Usage exceeds the approved allowance.
settlementExplanation: Check the existing operation to retry settlement. This does not create or purchase another voice.
statusUpdatesPaused: Automatic status updates paused. Check this existing operation to continue.
statusCheckFailed: The status check failed. Your description and existing operation are preserved; try checking again.
